item.title: Flipkart在印度孟加拉鲁开始国内食品运送试点
item.author: Umesh Ellichipuram
item.description:
本地机器翻译 · 原文附后

Walmart支持的Flipkart公司已开始在孟加拉鲁鲁的员工中测试食品运送服务,

NDTV 利润

报告。

试点标志着电子商务公司率先进入印度的在线食品提供市场.

熟悉此事的人告诉该出版物,由于Flipkart在更大范围推出前正在对产品和操作模式进行工作,服务正在"在内部进行试点".

Flipkart计划本月晚些时候向孟加拉鲁鲁的消费者开放这项服务。

7月时,

NDTV 利润

报告Flipkart正在探索通过一个单独的应用程序启动这一业务。

报告补充说,预计该服务也将在数字商业开放网络(ONDC)上提供。

该公司还在考虑为食品交付业务单独打牌,不过尚未就结构作出最后决定。

Flipkart先前曾表示,该提议最终既可以在独立的应用程序上提供,也可以通过其主要平台提供。

孟加拉鲁鲁之后,该公司正计划根据报告引用的资料来源,向孟买和德里-NCR扩展.

这一举动将使Flipkart进入以Swiggy和Eternal拥有的Zomato为主的市场。

同时,其他公司也在部分尝试不同的模型.

Rapido已经以零功率方式进入食品交付,而Swiggy和Zomato测试了针对不同消费群体的单独格式.

"Flipkart开始在印度孟加拉鲁鲁进行内部食品输送试点"最初由Flipkart创建并出版.

食品处

,一个GlobalData拥有的品牌.

原文：Flipkart begins internal food delivery pilot in Bengaluru, India

Walmart-backed Flipkart has started testing a food delivery service internally among employees in Bengaluru, according to an

NDTV Profit

report.

The pilot marks the e-commerce company's first move towards entering India's online food delivery market.

People familiar with the matter told the publication that the service is being "piloted internally" as Flipkart works on the product and operating model before a wider launch.

According to the report, Flipkart plans to open the service to consumers in Bengaluru later this month.

In July,

NDTV Profit

had reported that Flipkart was exploring launching the business through a separate app. The report added that the service is also expected to be available on the Open Network for Digital Commerce (ONDC).

The company is also considering separate branding for the food delivery business, although a final decision on the structure is yet to be taken.

Flipkart had previously indicated that the offering could eventually be available both on a standalone app and through its main platform.

After Bengaluru, the company is planning expansion to Mumbai and Delhi-NCR, according to the sources cited in the report.

The move would bring Flipkart into a market dominated by Swiggy and Eternal-owned Zomato.

At the same time, other companies have been trying different models in the segment. Rapido has entered food delivery with a zero-commission approach while Swiggy and Zomato have tested separate formats aimed at different consumer groups.

"Flipkart begins internal food delivery pilot in Bengaluru, India" was originally created and published by

Verdict Food Service

, a GlobalData owned brand.
